cohort: A cohort of 150 pregnant individuals with a history of acute SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy, predominantly identifying as Black and/or Latina.
finding: 26.7% of pregnant individuals with acute SARS-CoV-2 infection experienced at least one Long COVID symptom, with pain, mental health dysfunction, and fatigue being the predominant symptoms.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates showed notable trends between subcohorts categorized by the presence or absence of Long COVID symptomology.
followup_time: at least 30 days following a COVID-19 diagnosis
